recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If further follow-up is desired, verify the external IG template/sample IG repository, but do not add redundant or default-changing table CSS in the core specification for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-25443 requested gridlines by default for new IG template tables. It was Applied with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification: do not change the long-standing no-lines default because a table class already enables grid lines; instead update sample-ig examples to show tables with and without grid lines.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit explicitly tagged FHIR-25443 was found. Current source already contains the table.grid CSS class in source/fhir.css and tools/templates/fhir.css, and git pickaxe history shows that support predates the Jira issue and was carried into tools/templates/fhir.css during the 2021 build refactor. The Jira's 2025 applied comment says whatever was going to be done has been done.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM minutes repeat the same decision: FHIR-25443 would not change the default and would add examples with and without grid lines. The originating Zulip discussion records the opt-in class approach and that Kramdown syntax such as {: .grid } applies the grid class to Markdown tables. In this checkout, source/fhir.ini does not include sample-ig as an active build input, and tracked-source searches found no sample-ig grid example source to edit in FHIR core.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source change was made because changing default table CSS would contradict the accepted disposition, while the only remaining sample-ig example action is not represented in the current FHIR-core build/source scope.
